out.explanation: Page 369 defines Total Secured Loans as 499.48 million, which excludes the unsecured loan of 10.19 million, whereas page 364 aggregates fund-based, non-fund-based, and unsecured loans to arrive at a total borrowing figure of 509.67 million. These two statements measure different scopes of borrowings, as one represents strictly secured loans while the other represents the grand total including unsecured loans.
